name: Invisible Paths
source:
After making a sketchy deal with the devil, a girl whose life was cut tragically short emerges into the world as a ghost, and sets about trying to both make sense of her death and find a way to rest in peace.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20325]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩和恶魔达成了可疑的交易，但她的生命悲惨地戛然而止。她以鬼魂的形态回到世上，试图理解自己的死亡，并寻找安息的方法。

[来自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20325]Lemma Soft 论坛[/url]]
